title: Deep review of @tldraw/store for correctness bugs
reason: Rolls up regression-backed fixes for transaction rollback visibility, undo correctness, reactive subscriptions, atom/map behavior, migrations, and schema handling. The split child fixes are distinct evidence and are not considered verified from the parent summary alone.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve does not embed @tldraw/store, but its document store/history/reactivity are analogous correctness boundaries. Child fixes and tests should be inspected against the Varve engine before concluding there is no shared regression risk.

title: Reference docs treat @tldraw/editor React components as variables and functions
reason: The tldraw API generator skips React component exports from @tldraw/editor and emits misleading variable/function reference pages. This concerns the upstream SDK documentation generator and its package model.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve has no published tldraw-compatible React SDK reference generator; its Astro documentation describes Varve product workflows.

title: Add reference docs for the commenting, mentions, collaboration, and sync-collaboration packages
reason: Requests reference pages for tldraw commenting, mentions, collaboration, and sync-collaboration packages. These APIs are specific to upstream packages not shipped by Varve.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve does not ship the four tldraw collaboration packages. Its local-first product has no direct reference-page gap matching these exports.

title: Docs link checker accepts wrong-case heading anchors that are dead on the rendered page
reason: The tldraw docs checker lowercases fragments and heading IDs although rendered heading IDs preserve case, allowing dead links to pass. The issue identifies a concrete docs-tooling defect that should be compared with Varve’s own anchor validator.

varveAssessment.assessment: scripts/audit-docs.mjs lowercases Markdown heading slugs and link fragments; the Astro search extractor likewise lowercases generated heading IDs. Both relevant Varve surfaces therefore match their rendered slug convention. No matching case-sensitive-heading mismatch was found.

title: Remove the stale add-framer-rewrites script and workflow
reason: Reports an obsolete Framer sitemap workflow that can restore removed rewrites into the tldraw docs app. No discussion was available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Repository search found no Framer rewrite workflow, stale Framer sitemap script, or matching `add-framer-rewrites` command in Varve.

title: Deep review of the docs app for correctness bugs
reason: Aggregates reference-page collisions, sidebar/navigation, link checking, keyboard shortcut, feedback tracking, bundle-size, dead-code, and dependency fixes in the tldraw docs app. The linked child issues remain separate evidence nodes.

varveAssessment.assessment: The case-sensitive anchor-checking scenario was compared against scripts/audit-docs.mjs and the Astro heading slugger: both generate lowercase heading IDs and compare lowercase fragments. Other tldraw docs-app findings refer to a different Next.js documentation architecture and are not imported into Varve.

title: Cancelled touch or pen pointer leaves the canvas stuck in a pointing state
reason: Reports canceled touch/pen input leaving tool state active, then confirmed the fix in #10464; later comments note #10690 fixed a palm/pen interaction regression and that lostpointercapture was intentionally declined upstream. Varve has explicit pointercancel dispatch and lost-capture cleanup, but this batch is adding browser regression coverage for cancellation and recovery.

varveAssessment.assessment: packages/editor/src/canvas/inputPipeline.ts dispatches React pointercancel to the active tool, cancels the recorded interaction, clears pointer ownership, and separately handles lostpointercapture. Existing E2E covers multi-touch cancellation but not an OS-style pointercancel followed by a clean new draw; a focused Chromium regression was added and awaits verification.

title: TLSessionStateSnapshot's iOS detector disagrees with tlenv.isIos on iPadOS
reason: Reports two tldraw iOS detectors disagreeing on iPadOS Safari’s desktop user agent, affecting gesture listener selection and coalesced pointer events. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve has no equivalent central `isIos` switch controlling both gesture routing and coalesced canvas input; current touch/layout capability decisions are based on pointer capabilities. Device-specific iPadOS gesture validation remains outside this code comparison.

title: Safari pencil double-tap zoom suppression never runs because its touch listeners check instanceof PointerEvent
reason: The upstream hook registers touchstart/touchend listeners but checks for PointerEvent, so its intended Apple Pencil branch cannot run for TouchEvent. The issue itself leaves delete-versus-repair and device validation as a product decision.

varveAssessment.assessment: No matching Safari pencil double-tap suppression hook was found in Varve. Adding platform-specific suppression without real iPad Pencil validation would risk changing browser zoom/accessibility behavior, so this is recorded without a code change.

title: Shape styles and culling registration are lost when the ShapeWrapper component identity changes
reason: Reports transforms, dimensions, opacity, z-index, clip-path, and culling registration being applied only to the initial wrapper element when a custom ShapeWrapper changes identity. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve does not expose the same pluggable ShapeWrapper component API; its canvas uses its own compositor and overlays rather than React shape wrappers. The specific remount/culling path has no direct equivalent.
